items.title: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE (StyleSmuggler) under active attack
items.summary: An unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability actively exploited in the wild, affecting Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source versions 2.4.4 through 2.4.9.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
items.summary: A high-severity path traversal vulnerability addressed as part of APSB26-138.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability addressed as part of APSB26-138.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This bulletin addresses seven vulnerabilities, including critical unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362), stored cross-site scripting, and authorization flaws.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass.
